facts: Main island Grande Terre, plus the Loyalty Islands and the Isle of Pines
worth_knowing: The territory lies 1,210 km east of Australia and 220 km southwest of Vanuatu. The four inhabited Loyalty Islands off the east coast are Ouvéa, Lifou, Tiga and Maré.
